name: China Security Co., Ltd.
summary: China Security Co., Ltd. develops and markets electronic security solutions for both the Chinese domestic market and international clients. Their extensive service offerings encompass secure cash logistics, financial asset protection, human capital security, sophisticated electronic safeguarding, and comprehensive facility management, in addition to various other protective services. Founded in 1987 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, the company formerly conducted business as China Security & Fire Co., Ltd. before adopting its current name, China Security Co., Ltd., in May 2018.
